construction: Equal-weighted, monthly-rebalanced, buy-and-hold between rebalances; dated membership changes take effect same-day.
history_note: Curated 2026-06 with knowledge of the period — the full ~3y series is a HINDSIGHT backtest of the as-of-creation membership, not an out-of-sample track. A monitoring/structure frame, not a buy list.
note: Equal-weight thematic baskets over the FREE price universe. Membership is explicit, dated and auditable. Curated 2026-06 with knowledge of the period, so the full ~3y series is HINDSIGHT-curated and descriptive — not an out-of-sample backtest. Prices come from the breadth caches plus a baskets-only DEEP close store (data/baskets/extras.parquet): it carries on-thesis names outside the S&P-1500 (recent IPOs, crypto & nuclear) AND a deep ~3y tape for large-caps the breadth cache only holds in a ~15-month rolling window — so baskets render full history instead of a short stub. Recent IPOs / late entrants are still flagged partial where their own tape is short.
